name: Gojira Mod
description: June and Leon's kaiju: Gojira, a giant (54.67 = 164/3 blocks tall) charcoal-grey dinosaur-like ocean monster with a long tail and jagged pale plates down its back. It swims in the ocean and wades onto land, is always angry at every creature it meets, stomps, swipes its claws, whips its tail, roars "SKREEONK!" and breathes a glowing white beam. It can't be beaten: it heals faster than you can hurt it (if a grown-up /kills it underwater, it leaves a giant bone skeleton on the sea floor). Spawn it with the Gojira Spawn Egg. NEW in 0.2.0: Showa Godzilla, June's hero of humanity, just as big, who protects players and villagers, fights only hostile mobs (and Gojira), flies by blasting his beam backward like a rocket, drop-kicks, and does a victory dance.
